page.content:
Nexus-6 combat model who wants more life.

How Roy Batty connects

  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — Roy Batty is the Nexus-6 leader of the 1982 film.
  • Faction: Replicants — Roy leads the escaped Nexus-6 group.
  • Concept: Nexus-6 — Roy is a Nexus-6 combat model.
  • Character: Rick Deckard — Deckard's hunt ends in Roy's rooftop mercy.
  • Character: Eldon Tyrell — Roy confronts Tyrell as a son who wants more life.

What is Roy Batty?

Roy Batty is the leader of the escaped Nexus-6 group, the one who reaches Tyrell, quotes Blake, and dies in the rain after saving Deckard.

Key threads lead to Blade Runner (1982), Replicants, Nexus-6, Rick Deckard and Eldon Tyrell.
